title: DOMAINS.md defines the domains; each domain's detail lives with it
description: Serves "Nothing breaks the viewers' evening.". Seen now: every agent reads the 141 KB file on every task and its tools cut lines short. It runs after JS-194, which deletes the Jellyfin-only invariants. DOMAINS.md is 141 KB, with single invariants thousands of words long on one line. Every agent reads it on every task, readers' tools cut its lines short, and it drifts from the code. It becomes the definition of the domains: for each domain its vocabulary, its boundary (what it owns and must not do), and its guarantees as numbered rules of one to three sentences. Each rule's full statement, rationale, measurements, tables, tests and history move whole to one file per domain under docs/domains/, read by tasks that touch that domain. Invariant numbers do not change. Documents and their checks only; no behaviour changes.
acceptanceCriteria: DOMAINS.md is organised by domain: each has its vocabulary, its boundary (owns, must not) and its rules; every invariant belongs to exactly one domain; the preamble says what the file is, that a rule and its section in the domain file bind together, and that a change which bends either updates both in the same change

Every invariant in DOMAINS.md is one to three sentences and at most 600 characters, keeps the number it has today (none renumbered or reused; a new rule takes the next number), and links to its section in its domain file
DOMAINS.md has no line over 600 characters and is under 40 KB in all; no domain file has a line over 1,000 characters
Each domain file under docs/domains/ has one section per rule, headed by the rule's number, holding its full statement, rationale, measurements, tables and the names of its tests
Nothing is lost: a check finds each old invariant's full text under its number in its domain file, and a check lists every old invariant's tests against the new files and fails when one is missing
No guarantee is weakened: a short rule contradicts nothing in its section, and any statement that says less than today's cites a decision id from tasks/decisions/
Every existing citation still resolves: shown by one search run when the task closes, its output recorded; no committed check reads code, docs/, ARCHITECTURE.md or tasks/.

The pointers change in the same change: CLAUDE.md, the role files in .claude/agents/ (the product owner's read list included) and the build workflow's instructions say every agent reads DOMAINS.md, and a task's agents also read the domain file of each domain the task touches
notes: Extended from the Fable 5.2 blind audit, 2026-11-14. Amended 2026-11-19 at the owner's request, decided by the product owner. Starts from a main that holds JS-089's and JS-135/JS-136's DOMAINS edits; a move, not a rewrite; does not hold the people tasks.
